remarks: Welcome Home!! Centrally located 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath end unit townhouse. Plenty of natural light. No need to do anything here. Harwood floors on main level, living room/dining room open floor plan is great for entertaining. Sliders to patio. Stainless steel appliances, white quartz countertop. The bedrooms are nice size with vaulted ceilings and skylights. Plenty of closet space. Conveniently located close to Sono Collection Mall, the train station. PLEASE BE KIND TO WEAR THE BOOTIES PROVIDED. THANK YOU!
